title: openams_spoolman component status, version 1 (C4)
description: TO ADD (H4). The Moonraker component's status object (ARCHITECTURE §5 C4: {bays: {unit-bay: {spool_id, source, pending_confirmation}}, spoolman_online}), plus the per-bay linker state (§3), the offline write-queue depth (§6), and the spool summary. RESOLVED (review, C2 4/7): the spool summary (material, color, vendor, remaining) lives HERE, not in oams_manager/openams_ui, since the host never talks HTTP and Spoolman owns the facts; the display merges openams_ui with this object. Served by a Moonraker endpoint and pushed as a notification (C4 §8).

edit.description: Capability flag (C4 §9): present and true when the component serves the edit endpoint. Additive; a component without it omits the key.

stop.description: Capability flag (C3, C4 §9.1): present and true when the component serves the stop route (POST /server/openams/stop), which stops the whole running load, unload or toolchange sequence. Additive; a component without it omits the key.

queued_writes.description: Spoolman writes waiting for Spoolman to come back (C4 §6).

tray_sync.description: Additive (C4 §7.5): present only on a linked bay whose unit stores a per-bay filament setting and is kept in step with the spool. in_sync: the unit holds the spool's filament; pending: a write waits or was just sent; kept: the unit holds another setting that is left alone, since it decided the link or the spool has not changed since it was last in step; failed: the writes for the spool's latest change did not take (error says why).

suggestions.description: Additive (C4 §4.1): present only on an unlinked bay whose unit-decoded tag matches several Spoolman spools. The candidates a UI can offer; the component never picks one itself.

spool.description: The linked spool's summary, as last read from Spoolman (or the offline cache, C4 §6). null when unlinked/resolving or not yet known.

initial_g.description: The spool's initial_weight, else the filament's nominal weight, else null. Additive: a UI prefills the edit form's initial weight from it (C4 §8).

flow_k.description: The spool's extra.flow_k pressure advance, or null when unset or not a number (C4 §7.2). Additive.
